Staff may borrow a meeting-room key for a confirmed booking. Return it to reception before leaving the building. If reception is closed, use the locked key box beside its desk. Do not leave keys in the meeting room.

Open your invitation link within 48 hours. If it has expired, ask the inviter for a new link.

Administrators assign workspace access separately. You may log in successfully and still see an empty workspace list; ask an administrator about your access.

The riverside walking route has reopened on the main gravel path between Mill Bridge and the old ferry landing. The lower boardwalk and the short staircase from the landing to the water remain closed. Follow the entrance map and temporary barriers; an open bridge gate does not mean all areas are open. No completion date has been set for the remaining repairs.

The path may close without notice during heavy rain or changing water levels. Check the entrance board: its closure notices take priority over older reopening announcements.

**Access and toilets**

The picnic area can be reached from Mill Bridge without steps by wheelchair users and visitors with strollers. Beyond it, a short section has loose gravel and a steep cross-slope. A full-route accessibility assessment has not been completed.

The accessible toilet in the bridge car park is open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. The ferry landing toilet is closed.

**Dogs and bicycles**

Dogs are welcome on the open path on a lead. From March 1 through July 31, dogs are excluded from the marked nesting zone beside the reed beds, even on a lead. You may still walk your dog along the main path beside the zone.

Cycling is permitted from Mill Bridge to the picnic area, with pedestrians having priority. Beyond the picnic area, dismount and walk your bicycle to the ferry landing. This applies to conventional and electric bicycles, but not mobility aids.

**Parking**

Mill Bridge parking costs $3 for up to two hours or $5 for the day. Machines accept cards only. There is no separate walking admission fee, and visitors arriving on foot do not need a parking ticket.

**Optional guided walk**

A local volunteer group offers a free guided walk at 10 a.m. on the first Sunday of each month. Registration is required, with places limited to twelve people. Registration reserves your walk place only; it does not reserve parking or waive parking charges.

From September 1, request access to the museum’s photographic collection through the collection portal. Staff can help you complete a request by phone if you cannot use the portal. Email requests received before September 1 remain in the existing queue; do not submit them again. Later email requests will receive instructions for using the portal.

Provide your contact details, a brief description of your research purpose, and the collection reference if you know it. If you don’t, give as much descriptive information as possible; a reference number is not required.

Staff first check for an existing usable scan. Existing scans normally take up to five working days to supply after the item is identified. New scanning has no fixed turnaround during the conservation backlog.

**Conservation and privacy reviews**

The conservation team decides whether an original can be handled safely. If scanning would risk damage, the collections team will explain any available alternatives, which may include an older reference image, a catalog description, or supervised viewing. These depend on the item’s condition and restrictions and are not guaranteed. Where possible, staff will explain why scanning or access is restricted.

Requests containing personal information about living people may need an additional privacy review before access is granted. No deadline has been promised for these reviews. Conservation, privacy, and rights checks are separate; clearing one does not clear the others.

**Charges**

Reference scans are free for individual research requests involving up to ten images. Larger requests are reviewed for staffing time and may carry a quoted service charge. Chargeable work begins only after you accept the quote. The ten-image allowance applies to the total request, including related submissions for the same project; submitting them separately does not automatically create additional allowances. Staff may ask about related requests to establish the total.

**Publication permissions**

Receiving a reference scan for private study does not grant permission to publish it in a book, website, exhibition, or commercial product. You are responsible for obtaining any necessary publication permissions. The museum can grant permission only for rights it controls.

Catalog rights information is incomplete. “No rights holder recorded” means only that none is listed in the museum’s current record; it does not establish that an image is in the public domain. Staff can share recorded information but cannot promise to identify every rights holder. A scanning charge does not buy a publication license or transfer copyright, and the new request process does not change ownership of the photographs.

The east lift is out of service after stopping between floors at 8:10 a.m. with two passengers inside. The service team opened the doors at 8:27 a.m., and both passengers left without reported injury. The west lift remains available.

A worn door sensor was found and a replacement is on order, but the cause of the stoppage has not been confirmed. The east lift will remain unavailable until checks are complete; we do not yet have a return-to-service date.

Do not confirm installers for October 5 yet. Operations reports delivery booked for October 4, but the supplier portal, checked later, lists estimated dispatch on October 4 with delivery pending. The purchase order says the delivery date is still to be agreed. These sources do not establish a confirmed delivery date.

Ask the supplier and Operations to reconcile the booking and confirm the delivery date in writing, explicitly distinguishing dispatch from arrival. Use that confirmation to decide whether October 5 installation is feasible.

We recommend keeping the weekday shuttle through November, subject to budget committee approval. Average weekday ridership was 42 in September and 39 in October, and the shuttle serves the clinic on Tuesdays when there is no public bus.

Weekend ridership was not measured, so these data do not support extending weekend service. We propose counting weekend riders for four weeks before deciding.
The duplicate-import hypothesis isn’t supported: I found no duplicates. A timezone filter excludes seven rows, and I’m comparing stored timestamps with the filter boundaries to determine why.

The three buttons have identical color and size, and testers repeatedly chose Cancel instead of Save. Give Save a filled accent color and make Cancel an outlined button so the actions are easier to distinguish.
There’s a bit of a queue this morning, folks. Just dropping off a form? Pop it in the blue tray and you’re good to go. Payments still need the counter.

The new reminder subject line got 41 opens out of 100, compared with 44 out of 100 for the old line. We haven’t run a statistical analysis, so this result doesn’t establish a reliable difference. We’ll keep the old line for now and test a different send time next week.
The reduced rate applies to stays of 3–6 nights. Seven-night bookings use the weekly rate; two-night bookings use the standard rate.
Editors can suggest changes, but only owners can approve publication. An owner’s approval covers that version only. It does not approve future versions or changes to who has access.

Lab A reported 12 mg/L and Lab B reported 19 mg/L. The samples were collected on different dates using different methods, and no method comparison is available. These results do not establish why the measurements differ or that either is incorrect.
Restart the pump only when the inlet valve is open and the pressure gauge reads below 20 psi. If either condition is not met, call the supervisor.

Enrollment lets you request a travel grant, but does not guarantee an award. Awards depend on available funds and approval of your proposed trip. Booking before approval does not increase your priority.

Outages fell from 10 in the month before the maintenance change to 6 in the month after. The decrease does not establish that maintenance caused it: weather was milder in the second month, and usage was not recorded.
We will replace defective stitching reported within one year of purchase. This guarantee excludes fabric fading, accidental damage, and normal wear. Keep proof of purchase.

Do not hire either candidate yet. Hiring requires a passed practical test and two satisfactory references. Candidate A passed the test but still needs to supply two references for review. Candidate B supplied both references but failed the test; the information provided also does not establish that those references are satisfactory.
